## Palo Alto Networks shares trade at a large premium to fair-value estimates as AI security re-rating persists

A large reported premium to model fair value on a name trading on an AI-security re-rating is a meaningful risk flag; if AI tailwinds disappoint or the premium compresses, PANW is among the most exposed names in the security space.

- A simplywall.st model pegs PANW at 153% above its fair-value estimate — the specific figure is stated in the headline.
- The AI security narrative is cited as the driver of the valuation premium.
- The story frames this as a valuation risk flag, not a fundamental upgrade.
- Source is a third-party valuation tool; no sell-side or company disclosure is involved.
